name: Mate 40

Body.Dimensions: Mate 40 , 158.6 mm H , 72.5 mm W , 8.8 mm, Mate 40 Pro/Pro+, 162.9 mm H , 75.5 mm W , 8.8-9.1 mm
Body.Weight: Mate 40: 188 g, Mate 40 Pro: 212 g, Mate 40 Pro+: 230 g

Platform.Operating system: EMUI 13, based on Android 12 (SDK ROM), HarmonyOS 2.0 (China 2021 variant), Current: China: HarmonyOS 4.2
Platform.CPU: Octa-core (1x3.13 GHz Cortex-A77 & 3x2.54 GHz Cortex-A77 & 4x2.05 GHz Cortex-A55)

Memory.RAM: Mate 40/Pro: 8 GB RAM, Mate 40 Pro+: 12 GB RAM
Memory.Storage: Mate 40: 128 or 256 GB UFS 3.1, Mate 40 Pro/Pro+: 256 GB UFS 3.1, Mate 40 RS Porsche Design: 512 GB UFS 3.1
Memory.Card slot: Nano Memory, expandable up to 256 GB

Display.Display: Mate 40: 6.5 in OLED, (402 ppi), 19.8:9 aspect ratio, 90 Hz refresh rate, Mate 40 Pro/Pro+: 6.76 in OLED, (456 ppi), 18.5:9 aspect ratio, 90 Hz refresh rate

Cameras.Rear camera: All: 50 Megapixel, MP Wide (F-number, f/1.9, 23mm, 1/1.28", 2.44µm, PDAF, Laser AF), Dual Pixel Autofocus#Phase detection, PDAF, Leica optics, gyro-EIS, HDR, LED flash, 4K@30/60fps, 1080p@30/60/120/240/480fps, Mate 40 Pro: In addition to above: + 20 MP Ultrawide (f/1.8, 18mm, PDAF)	+ 12 MP Telephoto (f/3.4, 125mm, PDAF, OIS), 720p@960/3840fps, Mate 40 Pro+: In addition to Mate 40: OIS, + 20 MP Ultrawide (f/2.4, 14mm, PDAF), + 8 MP Telephoto (f/4.4, 240mm, PDAF, OIS) + 12 MP Telephoto (f/2.4, 80mm, PDAF, OIS) + Time-of-flight camera, time-of-flight sensor

Battery.Charging: Mate 40: 40 W wired + 40W wireless + reverse wireless charging, Mate 40 Pro/Pro+ 66 W, 50 W wireless, reverse wireless charging

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi, 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/6 with Wi-Fi Direct support, BT5.2, BLE, USB Type C 3.1
